_provenance: Usable observation-epoch windows per mission, derived 2026-07-09 from
empirical restrictions from cohort-curation Stage B triage failures.
The operator confirmed no additional SPK kernels are available, so
epochs outside these windows are permanently un-navigable locally.
VGISS windows are the union of VG1 and VG2 encounter SPKs (encounters
do not overlap, so the union is safe without knowing the spacecraft).
COISS is restricted to the Saturn tour: SPICE.db lists cruise-era SPK
and CK rows, but 1999-2003 frames fail with SPICE(NOFRAMECONNECT)
(patchy cruise CK), so the window starts at tour arrival.
CK coverage rows in SPICE.db are NOT trustworthy for filtering:
Voyager predict CKs claim coverage to 2027 yet scan-platform CKs have
holes inside the encounter windows; those residual holes are caught by
Stage B triage rather than this filter.
GOSSI is the SPK window intersected with the CK span (1995-10-09 to
2002-01-15); early-cruise Earth/Moon/Venus frames are not navigable.
